notes.core_blood_sorcery: Blood Sorcery unlocks Rituals up to the level of the Discipline. Corebook standard: Rouse Check, five minutes per level, and Intelligence + Blood Sorcery against Difficulty equal to Ritual level + 1 unless a Ritual states otherwise.
notes.oblivion_ceremonies: Oblivion Ceremonies use a similar framework but require a prerequisite Oblivion power. Players Guide: Resolve + Oblivion, Difficulty equal to Ceremony level + 1, five minutes per level unless stated otherwise.
notes.sourcebook_overlap: Some powers/rituals are revised or repeated between books. This JSON keeps sourcebook-specific entries rather than silently merging them.

Caitiff.special_rule: Three Disciplines of the player's choice following the Embrace; they are not considered in-clan for Experience cost purposes.

Thin-Blooded.special_rule: Thin-Blood Alchemy is the listed Discipline; thin-bloods can temporarily access other Disciplines through feeding and resonance rules.

access_rule.maximum_ritual_level: equal to current Blood Sorcery rating
access_rule.core_learning: At character creation, one Level 1 Ritual can be chosen with at least one dot in Blood Sorcery. Further Rituals cost ritual level × 3 Experience and require learning time.

access_rule.prerequisite: Each Ceremony has a prerequisite Oblivion power; a character must meet that prerequisite.
access_rule.learning: At character creation, one Level 1 Ceremony can be chosen when the prerequisite power is known. Further Ceremonies cost level × 3 Experience and require learning time and a teacher.
access_rule.source: Players Guide / Cults of the Blood Gods

Cults of the Blood Gods — Shalim.prerequisite_note: Shalimite Ceremonies use Oblivion powers from Chicago by Night as prerequisites.

Douse the Fear.ingredients: A holy object such as a crucifix, Bible, or Qur'an.
Douse the Fear.process: Expose the holy symbol to a flame without needing to destroy it.
Douse the Fear.system: +2 dice to rolls resisting Rötschreck; a critical win removes the need for Terror Frenzy rolls. Lasts one night.

Seal the Brand.ingredients: Molten silver poured over a tattoo, brand, or other body modification.
Seal the Brand.process: Pour molten silver over the mark. The target suffers Superficial damage, then the modification becomes permanent once mended.
Seal the Brand.system: The body modification becomes permanent and cannot be removed by other means.

As Fog on Water.ingredients: A piece of wood from a ship and water.
As Fog on Water.process: Submerge the wood in the target body of water while spilling Blood into it.
As Fog on Water.system: On a successful Ritual roll, the vampire can walk silently across the surface for the rest of the night.

Calix Secretus.ingredients: A hand-sized object and the user's Blood.
Calix Secretus.process: Drench the object in Blood and speak the Ritual words.
Calix Secretus.system: After an hour and a successful roll, Blood can be stored in the object. Every two Rouse Checks worth of stored Blood can sate one Hunger when released.

Soporific Touch.ingredients: A small amount of hashish or another narcotic.
Soporific Touch.process: Mix the substance with the user's Blood and rub it between the fingers while reciting the incantation.
Soporific Touch.system: After contact, the target resists the Ritual; on a win the target suffers a penalty equal to the margin on resistance pools involving Composure or Resolve for the remainder of the scene.

Fire in the Blood.ingredients: Target's blood sample, a visual depiction of the target, and a red-wax candle or iron lighter.
Fire in the Blood.process: Burn the blood sample while concentrating on the target's image.
Fire in the Blood.system: Contest the Ritual against Resolve + Occult or Resolve + Fortitude. Each margin success inflicts one Superficial Health damage and imposes a -2 Physical penalty for the scene; critical raises the penalty to -3.

One with the Blade.ingredients: A melee weapon and enough of the caster's vitae to immerse it.
One with the Blade.process: Submerge the weapon in Blood and swear an oath over it until the following sunrise.
One with the Blade.system: The weapon becomes mystically dedicated to the vampire. When anointed with the user's Blood it gains +2 dice in combat for one scene. Only one such weapon may be dedicated at a time.

Feast of Ashes.ingredients: Parchment with the target's name, the parchment's ashes, and the caster's Blood.
Feast of Ashes.process: Burn the parchment, collect the ashes, and use them with Blood to write the Ritual sigils.
Feast of Ashes.system: On a successful contest against Resolve + Willpower, the target cannot consume Blood for one night. Ash alone can sate Hunger, and cannot reduce it below 3.

Guided Memory.ingredients: Another vampire's vitae, dried rosemary, and fresh poppies or forget-me-nots.
Guided Memory.process: Burn the flowers and rosemary, blend the ashes with the donor's vitae, and drink it.
Guided Memory.system: Enters a guided Memoriam and may acquire a temporary Level 1-3 Discipline power or Merit appropriate to the memory. Gifts fade after the session.
Guided Memory.notes: The Storyteller decides the exact gift available from the Memoriam.

Invisible Chains of Binding.process: Inscribed with the caster's Blood over an hour and thrown at the target when activated.
Invisible Chains of Binding.system: Contest against Strength + Resolve. The target is unable to move from the spot for one hour per margin success while the link remains intact and within roughly 3 meters. The target suffers a four-dice penalty to physical defense, Brawl, and Melee actions.

Antebrachia Ignium.ingredients: Enough vampire vitae to coat the arms to the elbows and a flame source.
Antebrachia Ignium.process: Immerse both arms in Blood, then expose the coating to flame so the vitae ignites rather than the vampire.
Antebrachia Ignium.system: Creates controllable flames on the arms that can set targets alight and inflict Aggravated damage. Hunger 4+ requires a Hunger Frenzy test to avoid draining the ingredients.

Ishtar's Touch.ingredients: A small amount of hashish or another narcotic.
Ishtar's Touch.process: Mix the narcotic with the user's Blood and rub it between the fingers while chanting.
Ishtar's Touch.system: After contact, the target resists the Ritual. On a win, the target suffers a penalty equal to the Ritual margin on resistance pools involving Composure or Resolve for the scene.

One with the Blade.ingredients: A melee weapon and enough vitae to immerse it.
One with the Blade.process: Submerge the weapon in vitae and dedicate it until sunrise.
One with the Blade.system: Creates a mystically dedicated weapon that remains pristine while owned by the caster and can receive +2 dice when anointed with the caster's Blood.

Coax the Garden.process: Cast the blood-and-poppy-seed mixture onto the earth to rouse nearby plant life.
Coax the Garden.system: Animated plants impose a -2 Physical penalty within the affected area and can grapple victims. A critical win doubles plant damage; the effect lasts until the end of the scene.

Eden's Bounty.ingredients: A dead body, a living tree, one fresh apple, and one rotten apple.
Eden's Bounty.process: Place the body at the tree, healthy apple in its mouth and rotten apple in the caster's mouth; the body merges with the tree as nearby mortal blood is drawn through the earth.
Eden's Bounty.system: On a win, Hunger is reduced to 1; on a critical win, to 0 without killing. On a total failure, Hunger Frenzy occurs. Nearby kine suffer lasting physical penalties and Health damage.

Dampen the Fear.ingredients: A holy object such as a crucifix, Bible, or Qur'an.
Dampen the Fear.process: Expose the holy symbol to fire before interacting with fire.
Dampen the Fear.system: +2 dice to resist Rötschreck; critical success removes Terror Frenzy rolls. Lasts for the scene.

Fire in the Blood.ingredients: Target's blood sample, visual depiction, and red candle or iron lighter.
Fire in the Blood.process: Burn the target's blood while concentrating on their image.
Fire in the Blood.system: Contest against Resolve + Occult or Resolve + Fortitude. Margin inflicts Superficial Health damage and a Physical penalty; critical increases the penalty. Kindred targets must make a Rouse Check.

Creatio Ignis.ingredients: Enough vampire vitae to coat the caster's arms to the elbows and a flame source.
Creatio Ignis.process: Immerse arms in vitae and ignite the vitae coating.
Creatio Ignis.system: The caster's arms burn without harming the caster's arms and can inflict Aggravated damage on touched targets. Nearby vampires must test Terror Frenzy.

Traveler's Call.process: Invoke the Ceremony while holding the book and focusing on another Shalimite's name.
Traveler's Call.system: On a successful Ceremony roll the target receives a flashing vision of the caller's surroundings and suffers a -2 concentration penalty for the scene. A critical win permits a one-word message.

Name of the Father.ingredients: Ability to speak ancient Greek, eye contact with the victim, and five charcoal sticks.
Name of the Father.process: Recite an ancient Greek invocation while crushing charcoal and maintaining eye contact.
Name of the Father.system: On a successful contest against Resolve + Composure, the victim is paralyzed by despair for a number of turns equal to the margin. Willpower can be spent to break free.

Pit of Contemplation.ingredients: A pot of ink, three pints/six liters or more of blood from an innocent murdered by the caster, and an unlit room.
Pit of Contemplation.process: Paint a doorway on a wall with the victim's blood, then splash ink across it and open a tear into Oblivion.
Pit of Contemplation.system: A successful Ceremony creates a hole that draws air, objects, and people into a pocket of Oblivion. Mortals are killed instantly; undead remain trapped until released.

Odbiest.process: Sprinkle the substance over the ground and circle the area counterclockwise while focusing on the perimeter.
Odbiest.system: On success, animals, vermin, and similar low-intelligence life flee an area of roughly 100 square meters. Lasts one scene or one night.

Wspólny Wigor.ingredients: A claw/fingernail from the Pack Priest.
Wspólny Wigor.process: The priest breaks the nail into pieces, places theirs in the Vaulderie cup, and the pack members place pieces under their tongues.
Wspólny Wigor.system: On success, the pack's Blood Potency rises to the priest's Blood Potency and the priest gains +3 dice to Dominate or Presence tests against pack members for one night.

Galwaniczne Spustoszenie.process: Spread Blood over the coin and stomp on it.
Galwaniczne Spustoszenie.system: Disrupts electrical systems in an area roughly equivalent to a large warehouse or three-story building. Critical success keeps the failure relatively discreet; otherwise fires and alarms may result.

Brama-Symulakrum.ingredients: Materials to construct an exact copy of the destination and sacrificial victims.
Brama-Symulakrum.process: Build and blood-consecrate a physical replica of the destination over an extended preparation period.
Brama-Symulakrum.system: Creates a portal allowing a designated number of vampires to travel between the two locations. The portal remains open until the stated number of travelers has crossed.
